Method of Attack: Uses Dirty COW vulnerability to root Android devices and plant a backdoor
Backdoor collects information on infected devices
Backdoor used to subscribe users to premium SMS numbers in China
Uses KingoRoot rooting app and Iovyroot exploit (CVE-2015-1805) on ARM 32-bit devices instead of Dirty COW
Impacted Systems: Android devices with ARM 32-bit CPU architecture
Attack Vector: Malicious apps available via various online websites (not Google Play Store)
Indicators of Compromise: More than 1,200 malicious apps carrying ZNIU
About 5,000 infected users detected by Trend Micro
Infected apps mostly gaming and pornography related
Victims across 40 countries, mostly China and India
